mapper.insert: INSERT INTO selection_round (semester_id, name, type, status, start_time, end_time, max_wishes) VALUES (#{semesterId}, #{name}, #{type}, #{status}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{maxWishes})
mapper.select: SELECT id, semester_id, name, type, status, start_time, end_time, max_wishes, create_time FROM selection_round WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, semester_id, name, type, status, start_time, end_time, max_wishes, create_time FROM selection_round WHERE semester_id = #{semesterId} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE selection_round SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, semester_id, name, type, status, start_time, end_time, max_wishes, create_time FROM selection_round WHERE type = #{type} AND status = 1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM selection_round WHERE type = #{type} AND status = 1 AND semester_id = #{semesterId}
